blind_reimplementation.method: separate agent given only the spec and the restored feeds; forbidden from reading alpha_engine/. First comparison: 37 mismatched cells, all in game 662266 (feed whose last play is stamped before first pitch): the PRIMARY builder counted the game as its own prior. Primary fixed, rebuilt, 0 mismatches.

notes: Prediction cutoff is explicit: lead 0 = first pitch (features final by T-90m on 99.4% of rows), lead 24 = first pitch minus 24 h (final on 100% by construction). A forecast made earlier than first pitch must use the matching lead dataset.
games_remaining_pre is 162 minus completed games: a game cancelled and never made up is not subtracted (its cancellation time is not in the archive).
No starting-pitcher, lineup or injury column: those need timestamped pregame vintages, which the archive does not hold.

held_back.mlb.opp_strength: v1.1 run form is raw, not opponent- or venue-adjusted
held_back.mlb.sp_quality: no starter column in v1.1: starter identity is retrospective (box score)
held_back.mlb.opposing_probable_starter_vintage: needs timestamped pregame captures (28% of 2026 slots, none earlier)

catalog_inputs_eligible_for_promotion.note: mlb.pythag_luck = record vs Pythagorean and BaseRuns expectation plus one-run record, late-close record (within one run after six innings) and bullpen RA9. mlb.wins_to_date_and_games_remaining = wins, losses, ties, games remaining, run differential and unresolved (suspended / in-progress) games; the earlier downgrade (no game-status field in the schedule ledger) does not apply to the Stats API feeds used here.
